title: Durability HUD
description: DurabilityHUD is a mod that shows tool, weapon, and armor durability directly on your HUD. Never get surprised by a breaking pickaxe again
body: DurabilityHUD is a simple mod that displays the exact remaining durability of your tools, weapons, and armor directly on your screen. It makes it easy to keep track of every equipped armor piece and held item, helping you know when gear is close to breaking without opening your inventory.
